---
title: "Walmart Openings"
subtitle: "Maps showing Walmart store openings per decade."
format: html
engine: knitr
---

Recreates [Walmart
Openings](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/walmart-openings.html)
from the mosaic/vgplot example gallery (adapted from an [Observable
Plot example](https://observablehq.com/@observablehq/plot-map-large-multiples)).
Requires the DuckDB `spatial` extension.

```{r setup}
library(vgplotr)
```

```{r}
spec <-
  vg_create() |>
  vg_meta(
    title = "Walmart Openings",
    description = "Maps showing Walmart store openings per decade. Requires the DuckDB `spatial` extension.",
    credit = "Adapted from an [Observable Plot example](https://observablehq.com/@observablehq/plot-map-large-multiples)."
  ) |>
  vg_data(
    name = "states",
    type = "spatial",
    file = vg_data_url("us-counties-10m.json"),
    layer = "states"
  ) |>
  vg_data(
    name = "nation",
    type = "spatial",
    file = vg_data_url("us-counties-10m.json"),
    layer = "nation"
  ) |>
  vg_data(name = "walmarts", file = vg_data_url("walmarts.parquet")) |>
  vg_mark_geo(data_from = "states", stroke = "#aaa", stroke_width = 1) |>
  vg_mark_geo(data_from = "nation", stroke = "currentColor") |>
  vg_mark_dot(
    data_from = "walmarts",
    x = ~longitude,
    y = ~latitude,
    fy = ~ sql("10 * decade(date)"),
    r = 1.5,
    fill = "blue"
  ) |>
  vg_mark_axis_fy(frame_anchor = "top", dy = 30, tick_format = "d") |>
  vg_plot(margin = 0, fy_label = NULL, projection_type = "albers")

vg_render(spec)
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Comparing to mosaic's own JSON spec

```{r}
cat(to_json(spec))
```

Matches [mosaic's own JSON
spec](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/walmart-openings.html)
exactly, aside from `data.states.file`/`data.nation.file`/
`data.walmarts.file` (`vg_data_url()` vs. a relative path) and object
key order.
:::
